item.title: SkillPass: Portable Service Rights on CKB — Looking for Community Feedback (2 posts)
item.description: Hi CKB community, I’m building SkillPass, an open-source experiment for portable service rights on CKB, and I’d like feedback before preparing a formal Community Fund DAO proposal. What is SkillPass? A provider issues a service entitlement as a CKB Capability Cell. The current owner of the live Cell is the user authorized to access the service. Alice owns the Cell → Alice has access. If Alice transfers it to Bob: Alice loses access → Bob gains access. Providers verify the current live Cell on CKB instead of relying on a shared ownership database. SkillPass separates: CKB Capability Cell — ownership of the service right Fiber/x402 — optional per-use payment Current status A working Testnet...

item.title: Spark Program | CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint：可复现的 RISC-V 语义差分工具、Lean 4 证明与 Rocq/Coq 兼容性 Spike (2 posts)
item.description: Week6 本周未关闭，不宣布 PASS。本地工程与验收基础设施已经完成：12 槽聚合器、全部验收器、独立临时 VM 的 clean-room 执行路径、固定输入包的公开发布（1.80 GB xz，哈希已核对）以及冻结并推送的候选源码，都已落地并有回归测试。尚未关闭的是五个依赖外部动作的槽：clean-room 全链完成、CI 下载重放、维护者的交付批准、immutable release 和独立第三方复现。计划原文要求"未满足的项目按限制发布，不修改验收定义来制造完成状态"，我照此执行。 真实 clean-room 已在全新 KVM 环境里实跑五次，每次都暴露一个只有在干净环境才会出现的缺陷：引导顺序、被 Git 忽略的目录、缺失的 rustup/jq/m4、预检探针触发的未固定网络下载。这些在本机上永远跑不出来，现在每一个都已修正并有测试，这正是 Definition of Done 要求"能在干净环境重现"的意义。目前第五次实跑已越过安装与模型重建阶段，正在执行后续证明与差分阶段。每次重跑都需要耗时4-5h左右。 同时，我本周由于右臂肌肉拉伤，因此只能靠左臂进行作业，进度拖慢了不少，sail verification可能需要延迟交付。

item.title: Spark Program | Fiber RGB++ Swap (1 posts)
item.description: Hi all, Week 4 done, and with it the full scope. Closing update on Fiber RGB++ Swap. What Week 4 was: testing, demo, docs. Testing. Ran the complete two-node flow on local testnet nodes: hub publishes a signed ad, listener discovers it over gossip sync, best-rate picks the max, both books converge. Also verified expiry pruning (day-old ads correctly disappear from listings) and the CLI (fnn-cli swap_ad …) returning identical results to the API. One real bug found and fixed along the way: publishes originally only saved locally and waited on the peer’s next scheduled poll now publish also pushes straight into the gossip actor, so ads arrive within seconds, no manual re-sync.
